newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Goodman sees flat 1st half EBIT.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Goodman sees flat 1st half EBIT.

text.p: Australasian food group Goodman Fielder Ltd said on Friday it expected earnings before interest and tax (EBIT) in the first half of the 1996/97 financial year to be flat.
"The first half will be relatively flat," Goodman Fielder managing director David Hearn told reporters after the annual general meeting.
He said, however, that the second half would be much stronger to achieve the 10 percent-plus earnings forecast for the 1996/97 year to June 30.
"Certainly there will be a much stronger second half than in the first because of the impact of wheat costs," Hearn said.
He later said that Goodman's own earnings forecasts for 1996/97 were generally in line with those of market analysts.
"They have expected us to do reasonably this year and I think our estimate this year confirms their estimates or their forecasts rather than says any different," Hearn said.
"The market's forecasting numbers not far away from where we are," he said.
